assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: full-screen landscape background illustration for the HEXFRONT cozy sci-fi game's menu and results. Cute round hovering white/orange service drone with dark face and two cyan eyes, little side thrusters. Sunlit lush meadow with little daisies, distant soft rocky valley, pine trees and turquoise river. Put the HQ and drone in the RIGHT half, HQ near x=68%, drone x=80% y=38%. Left 40% is softly defocused meadow and scenery, lower visual contrast, intended for a separately coded menu overlay. Warm sunlight, calm welcoming cozy mood, tactile realistic toy materials, no warfare or destruction. Entire composition landscape wide.
